Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and for sharing the draft SOW. Below is a concise trial success and evaluation plan plus a RACI sketch that we can iterate on. I attached our suggested RACI spreadsheet and a filled security questionnaire (first pass) for your review.

Proposed trial success criteria (pass/fail + stretch):
- Latency: 95th percentile <= 400ms for 512-token inference (PASS). Stretch: 95th <= 300ms.
- Accuracy: Entity extraction F1 >= 0.88 on your benchmark (PASS). Stretch: F1 >= 0.92.
- Throughput: Sustained 50 concurrent sessions with <5% token error rate.
- Integration: API reachable over VPC peering and test workloads run end-to-end within 3 weeks of kickoff.
- Cost target: inferencing unit cost <= your internal target (we can model once usage numbers are firm).

Evaluation plan (who does what):
- Novastar: provide benchmark dataset + expected query distribution; run client-side integration tests; validate business-facing accuracy.
- Redwood (Irene / Karthik): run controlled load tests, provide latency and error-rate logs; produce evaluation report with token-level trace and cost estimate.
- Joint: end-to-end runbook with smoke tests for VPC connectivity and security checklist signoff.

RACI (summary):
- Infra (VPC, peering, capacity): Responsible = Novastar infra team / Accountable = Karthik (Redwood), Consulted = Lauren, Informed = Sarah
- Application integration (API calls, SDK): Responsible = Novastar eng, Accountable = Lauren (Redwood), Consulted = Irene, Informed = Sarah
- Security & compliance (questionnaire, audit logs): Responsible = Novastar security, Accountable = Marissa (Redwood sales/security liaison), Consulted = Karthik, Informed = Irene
- Procurement (SOW, PO, contract): Responsible = Novastar procurement, Accountable = Marissa (Redwood), Consulted = Irene, Informed = Sarah

Proposed timeline (rough):
- Week 0: Contract signature + security questionnaire exchange
- Week 1: VPC peering & test credentials
- Week 2: Integration & smoke tests
- Week 3: Full load testing and evaluation report
- Week 4: Joint review + accept/extend decision

I've attached: redwood_poc_raci.xlsx (spreadsheet with owner columns) and security_questionnaire_filled.docx (initial answers).

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_poc_raci.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)], [Attachment: security_questionnaire_filled.docx (DOCX, 90KB)]

If that looks good I'll copy this into a simple one-page mutual action plan and share with procurement/security.

Thanks —

Infra (Karthik): I can own operational work. Notes:
